# Dividend Guide
> A practical, step-by-step guide to dividend investing — learn how to pick dividend stocks, calculate yield, and build passive income.

## Core Pages
- [Dividend Guide](/): Complete introduction to dividend investing with key metrics, how-to timeline, and FAQ.
- [Best Dividend Stocks](/stocks): Curated lists of Dividend Aristocrats, high-yield, dividend growth, and monthly payers.
- [Dividend Calculator](/calculator): Free interactive tools for yield calculation, DRIP growth projection, and income goal planning.
- [Dividend Strategies](/strategy): Comparison of five strategies — DRIP, growth, high yield, Dogs of the Dow, covered calls.

## Articles
- [QQQI Dividend History](/articles/qqqi-dividend-history/): Complete NEOS Nasdaq 100 High Income ETF distribution history since its January 2024 launch, and how it compares to JEPQ and QYLD.
- [SCHD Dividend History](/articles/schd-dividend-history/): Every SCHD annual dividend since its 2011 launch, the 2024 stock split explained, and what 13 years of dividend growth delivers.
- [Dividend Stocks: How to Screen](/articles/dividend-dividend-stocks/): Step-by-step screening filters — yield, payout ratio, and growth streak — that separate quality dividend payers from yield traps.
- [Dividend Yield Explained](/articles/dividend-yield/): What dividend yield means, how to calculate it, what counts as good, and the high-yield traps to avoid.
- [High Dividend Stocks](/articles/high-dividend-stocks/): The best high-yield picks by sector (4-8% yields), why some pay reliably, and the structural risks.
- [Highest Dividend Stocks](/articles/highest-dividend-stocks/): The ultra-high-yield names — BDCs, mREITs, and closed-end funds paying 10-26% — and why most are risky.
- [JEPQ Dividend History](/articles/jepq-dividend-history/): Every JEPQ monthly distribution since its 2022 launch, annual totals, and what the record shows about total return.
- [NVDY Dividend History](/articles/nvdy-dividend-history/): YieldMax NVDA distribution history, the switch to weekly payouts, and why the 62% yield overstates the economics.
- [Tariff Dividend Check](/articles/tariff-dividend-check/): Current status of the proposed tariff dividend check, reported amounts, and how to track any real federal payment.
- [TSLY Dividend History](/articles/tsly-dividend-history/): YieldMax TSLA distribution history, the 2023 payout peak, the switch to weekly, and why the ~109% yield misleads.
- [VOO Dividend](/articles/voo-dividend/): VOO's current yield, annual dividend history since 2012, quarterly schedule, and how the S&P 500 ETF compares to SCHD and VIG.
- [Best Dividend Stocks 2025](/articles/best-dividend-stocks-2025/): The top dividend stocks of 2025 ranked — Aristocrats and high-yield picks with yields, streaks, and total returns.
- [JEPI Dividend](/articles/jepi-dividend/): JEPI's monthly distributions, current ~8% yield, history since 2020, and how JPMorgan's S&P 500 premium income ETF compares to JEPQ.
- [SPYI Dividend History](/articles/spyi-dividend-history/): Complete SPYI distribution history since 2022 — monthly payouts, the Section 1256 tax advantage, and how it compares to JEPI and QQQI.
- [QQQI Dividend](/articles/qqqi-dividend/): QQQI's ~14% yield explained — how the NEOS Nasdaq 100 High Income ETF generates income, the tax advantages, risks, and whether it's worth it.
- [Trump Tariff Dividend](/articles/trump-tariff-dividend/): The $2,000 per person tariff dividend proposal vs. the DOGE dividend — funding, feasibility, and why neither has been paid.
- [ULTY Dividend](/articles/ulty-dividend/): ULTY's ~106% yield evaluated — the real ~60% run-rate, heavy return of capital, and why total return is roughly flat.
